lines.en: label dormwar11:
{i}Somewhere...among a plethora of wieners...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在某个地方……在一大堆香肠中间……{/i}

lines.en: scene wienerfight1
: Futaba Fukuyama! Or should I say...temporary inhabitant and controller of the orc barbarian, Zagull Throat Spear!
lines.zh: : Futaba Fukuyama！或者我该称呼你为……兽人蛮战士 Zagull Throat Spear 的临时使用者兼操控者！

lines.en: : Um...Molly MacCormack...permanent controller of...the elf monk...
lines.zh: : 呃……Molly MacCormack……精灵武僧的……永久操控者……

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what was your character’s name again?
lines.zh: : 不好意思，你的角色叫什么来着？

lines.en: scene wienerfight2
: Alentha Amastacia, shadar kai servant of the Raven Queen and master of the elements.
lines.zh: : Alentha Amastacia，鸦后座下的沙达尔凯仆人，也是元素大师。

lines.en: : You’ve gotten yourself into quite the predicament, {i}Zagull...{/i}
lines.zh: : 你可真是把自己弄进了相当棘手的境地啊，{i}Zagull……{/i}

lines.en: : But I suppose you are {i}still{/i} a bit safer than you’d be if I were to be playing something more in my comfort zone...
lines.zh: : 不过我想，比起我用自己更拿手的角色，你现在{i}还{/i}算安全一点……

lines.en: : Yeah, aren’t you normally a druid, Molly?
lines.zh: : 对啊，Molly，你平时不是玩德鲁伊的吗？

lines.en: : Normally, yes. But that does not mean I’m not also well versed in the art of...monk stuff!
lines.zh: : 平时是。但这不代表我就不精通……武僧那一套！

lines.en: : In fact, Alentha here was my first serious character in all of Dungeons & Dragons.
lines.zh: : 事实上，Alentha 是我在整个《龙与地下城》里第一个认真玩的角色。

lines.en: : And since she is now up against Zagull, I suppose that makes her a canonical member of several different campaigns!
lines.zh: : 既然她现在要跟 Zagull 对上，那她应该算是好几个不同战役里的正统成员了！

lines.en: : Zagull is now about to meet his demise at the hand of someone who can not only traverse the shadows, but traverse time itself and exist in multiple dimensions at once!
lines.zh: : Zagull 马上就要死在一个不仅能穿行于阴影、还能穿越时间本身、同时存在于多个维度的人手里了！

lines.en: : Bow down before Alentha, mortal!
lines.zh: : 在 Alentha 面前跪下吧，凡人！

lines.en: scene wienerfight3
: You’re...really into this and we haven’t even started yet.
lines.zh: : 你……还真投入啊，我们都还没开始呢。

lines.en: : It’s Molly. What did you expect?
lines.zh: : 她可是 Molly。你还能指望什么？

lines.en: : Um...F...Futaba...
lines.zh: : 嗯……F……Futaba……

lines.en: : If you...need any help learning how Zagull works...I wouldn’t mind helping you...
lines.zh: : 如果你……需要人帮忙弄懂 Zagull 怎么玩……我不介意帮你的……

lines.en: scene wienerfight4
: I’ll be okay, Sana.
lines.zh: : 我没事的，Sana。

lines.en: : I haven’t played a barbarian before, but...I don’t think it seems all that complicated.
lines.zh: : 我以前没玩过蛮战士，不过……我觉得看起来也没那么复杂。

lines.en: : It’s definitely easier than keeping track of a million different spells, at least.
lines.zh: : 至少肯定比记一大堆法术要简单。

lines.en: : I just...don’t know if I’ll be able to effectively account for the fact that I will be playing with one less arm than I’m used to.
lines.zh: : 我只是……不知道自己能不能好好适应少一只手这件事。

lines.en: scene wienerfight2
: That’s right, my dear friend and soon-to-be loser of the day’s first competition!
lines.zh: : 没错，我亲爱的朋友、今天第一场比赛的准输家！

lines.en: : I refuse to allow Zagull’s arm to grow back for the sake of this competition as you {i}specifically{/i} stated that it would have no bearing on your ability to defeat Alentha.
lines.zh: : 我拒绝为了这场比赛让 Zagull 的手臂长回来，毕竟你{i}亲口{/i}说过，这不会影响你击败 Alentha 的能力。

lines.en: : Well...Alentha is a character you made years ago when you were less experienced...and it’s still a barbarian up against a monk.
lines.zh: : 嗯……Alentha 是你几年前还不熟练的时候做的角色……而且这好歹是蛮战士对武僧。

lines.en: : If I hit you even once it could be catastrophic.
lines.zh: : 我只要打中你一次，后果可能就很惨。

lines.en: scene wienerfight5
: That’s precisely the issue, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 问题恰恰就在这里，不是吗？

lines.en: : Do you truly think you’ll be able to land so much as a blow on a follower of the Raven Queen?
lines.zh: : 你真的以为，自己能打中鸦后的信徒哪怕一下吗？

lines.en: : I...really hope so. It would be quite a boring competition otherwise.
lines.zh: : 我……真希望能。不然这场比赛就太无聊了。

lines.en: scene black
scene wienerfight6
I show up at the Route 69 Diner to find the girls already in the middle of...some stuff that I don’t understand.
lines.zh: 我来到 69 号公路餐厅，发现女生们已经在搞……一些我完全看不懂的东西了。

lines.en: But I also find something that I understand completely.
lines.zh: 但我也发现了一件我完全看得懂的事。

lines.en: Something that is sure to make my morning quite entertaining.
lines.zh: 一件肯定能让我这个上午相当有趣的事。

lines.en: : I can explain.
lines.zh: : 我可以解释。

lines.en: : Cotton Candy Girl loves wieners! She can’t get enough of them!
lines.zh: : 棉花糖女孩爱死香肠了！怎么吃都吃不够！

lines.en: : Is this true, Niki?
lines.zh: : 是真的吗，Niki？

lines.en: : You love wieners?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢香肠？

lines.en: scene wienerfight7
: No! I don't fucking love wieners!
lines.zh: : 不是！我才他妈不喜欢香肠！

lines.en: : And it sounds fucking weird when {i}you{/i} say it!
lines.zh: : 而且{i}你{/i}这么说听着特别他妈奇怪！

lines.en: : But it doesn’t sound weird when Kaori says it?
lines.zh: : 那 Kaori 说就不奇怪了？

lines.en: : Everything that she says is weird, so no! Not really!
lines.zh: : 她说的每句话都很奇怪，所以不奇怪！一点都不！

lines.en: : Ahh, so you’re finally beginning to understand her.
lines.zh: : 啊，看来你终于开始懂她了。

lines.en: : She loves wieners so much! She won’t stop coming!
lines.zh: : 她太爱香肠了！一直来个不停！

lines.en: scene wienerfight8
: So...why are you here anyway?
lines.zh: : 所以……你到底为什么在这儿？

lines.en: : If you knew you were coming, you could have invited me or something. I don’t fucking care.
lines.zh: : 你要是早知道要来，本来可以叫上我什么的。我才他妈不在乎。

lines.en: : Really? Because that attitude makes it sound like you care quite a bit.
lines.zh: : 真的吗？你这态度听起来可是相当在乎啊。

lines.en: : Well, it’s better than you spending time with a bunch of [teenage]girls, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哼，总比你跟一群[teenage]女孩混在一起强吧？

lines.en: : So...if it’s to protect them, I’m sure I’d be able to put up with you for an hour or two.
lines.zh: : 所以……如果是为了保护她们，我肯定能忍你一两个小时。

lines.en: : That’s extremely considerate of you, Niki. Always looking out for today’s youth and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 你真是体贴入微啊，Niki。总是这么关心当代青少年什么的。

lines.en: : I didn’t really know I was coming, though. I’m here as part of a competition.
lines.zh: : 不过我不是事先知道要来的。我是因为比赛才到这儿的。

lines.en: scene wienerfight9
: Is that what’s going on over there? I know they’re playing D&D since the European looking girl is extremely loud, but I thought you weren’t into that kind of stuff?
lines.zh: : 那边是在搞这个吗？我看那个欧洲长相的女生嗓门特别大，就知道她们在玩龙与地下城，不过我还以为你不好这口呢？

lines.en: : I’m not. But, more importantly, you actually know what they’re playing?
lines.zh: : 我确实不好。不过更重要的是，你居然知道她们在玩什么？

lines.en: : Yeah. I used to play with a few of my friends from [high_school] in the manga club. I just never told you because you would have made fun of me for it.
lines.zh: : 对啊。我以前在漫画社跟几个[high_school]朋友一起玩过。只是没告诉过你，因为你肯定会笑我。

lines.en: : And you don’t think I’m going to make fun of you now?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得我现在就不会笑你了？

lines.en: scene wienerfight10
: I’m famous now, so I really don’t care what you make fun of me for.
lines.zh: : 我现在是名人了，所以你笑我什么我都无所谓。

lines.en: : Friendburger, would you like a wiener in your mouth this fine human morning?
lines.zh: : 朋友堡，在这个美好的人类早晨，你想来根香肠放进嘴里吗？

lines.en: : First Yuki...now Kaori. Why is everyone suddenly trying to put wieners in my mouth?
lines.zh: : 先是 Yuki……现在是 Kaori。怎么大家都突然想往我嘴里塞香肠？

lines.en: : Because they are juicy, delicious, and filled with growth hormones that make them taste better but also remove tens of dog years off of your lifespan!
lines.zh: : 因为它们多汁、美味，还满满都是生长激素，让它们更好吃，同时还能从你的寿命里减掉好几十个狗年！

lines.en: : Thanks, Kaori. And no, I will not be...partaking today.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Kaori。不，我今天就不……参与了。

lines.en: : Put the wiener in your mouth, {i}[nikitemp].{/i} Maybe you’ll like it.
lines.zh: : 把香肠放进嘴里吧，{i}[nikitemp]{/i}。说不定你会喜欢。

lines.en: : Jesus Niki, that name was a joke. You can stop calling me that now.
lines.zh: : 天啊 Niki，那个名字就是个玩笑。你现在可以别这么叫了。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}

lines.en: scene wienerfight11
: So, the dice have been cast and it appears that Alentha will be making the first move today.
lines.zh: : 那么，骰子已经掷下，看来今天由 Alentha 先手。

lines.en: : To reiterate, this will be a standard non-lethal one on one battle where we {i}are{/i} allowed to use our weapons.
lines.zh: : 重申一遍，这{i}是{/i}一场标准的非致命一对一战斗，我们可以使用武器。

lines.en: : Under normal circumstances against {i}normal{/i} barbarians, this probably isn’t a battle I would take. But the fact that Zagull only has one arm means I have very little to fear.
lines.zh: : {i}正常{/i}情况下对上正常的蛮战士，这场仗我大概不会接。但 Zagull 只有一只手臂，所以我基本没什么好怕的。

lines.en: : We’ve pre-balanced ourselves at level six to make things even, and the first person to be reduced to 0 HP will be declared the loser.
lines.zh: : 我们事先都平衡到了六级以求公平，先被打到 0 点生命值的人判负。

lines.en: : So, with that out of the way...
lines.zh: : 那么，闲话说完……

lines.en: : It’s time to die...
lines.zh: : 是时候去死了……

lines.en: : So much for non-lethal...
lines.zh: : 说好的非致命呢……

lines.en: scene wienerfight12
: Alentha springs into action, kicking off the ground and sprinting directly toward the one-armed barbarian, her quarterstaff tucked into a hempen holster on her back.
lines.zh: : Alentha 猛地跃起，脚下一蹬，直直冲向那个独臂蛮战士，她的长棍收在背后的麻绳套里。

lines.en: : Upon entering melee range, she gets into position, curls her fists into a perfect ball, and makes an unarmed attack against Zagull’s abdomen.
lines.zh: : 一进入近战距离，她就摆好架势，双拳握成完美的圆形，朝 Zagull 的腹部打出一次徒手攻击。

lines.en: scene wienerfight13
: Okay, she misses her first attack somehow.
lines.zh: : 好吧，不知怎么的，她的第一次攻击落空了。

lines.en: : What did you roll?
lines.zh: : 你掷了多少？

lines.en: : A 14, and I know from memory that Zagull’s AC is a 15. So yeah, first attack is a miss.
lines.zh: : 14 点，我记得 Zagull 的护甲等级是 15。所以嘛，第一击没中。

lines.en: scene wienerfight14
: Upon missing, Alentha repositions herself and unleashes another unarmed attack, this time aimed slightly higher!
lines.zh: : 落空之后，Alentha 重新调整姿势，又打出一次徒手攻击，这次瞄准的位置稍微高一点！

lines.en: scene wienerfight15
: That’s an...18 to hit. And...
lines.zh: : 那是……18 点命中。然后……

lines.en: scene wienerfight16
scene wienerfight17
: Six damage from the attack that connects.
lines.zh: : 命中那一击造成 6 点伤害。

lines.en: : Okay...anything else?
lines.zh: : 好……还有别的吗？

lines.en: : Obviously. I’m a monk.
lines.zh: : 当然有。我可是武僧。

lines.en: : After her second attack lands, Alentha expels a ki point to unleash a flurry of blows on Zagull, making two extra attacks as a result.
lines.zh: : 第二击命中之后，Alentha 消耗一点气，对 Zagull 发动疾风连击，因此多出两次攻击。

lines.en: : Can...monks really attack four times in one turn?
lines.zh: : 武僧……真的能在一个回合里攻击四次吗？

lines.en: : Under the right pretenses, yes. Which makes them well versed at handling situations like this so long as they’re able to not get hit.
lines.zh: : 在合适的条件下可以。这也是为什么只要不被打中，他们处理这种情况会很拿手。

lines.en: scene wienerfight16
: Now...third attack.
lines.zh: : 现在……第三次攻击。

lines.en: scene wienerfight15
scene wienerfight16
scene wienerfight15
: First attack lands for 5 damage.
lines.zh: : 第一击命中，造成 5 点伤害。

lines.en: scene wienerfight16
scene wienerfight15
: Aaaaand...I’m going to use a point of luck to reroll that last attack.
lines.zh: : 然——后……我要用一点幸运来重掷最后那次攻击。

lines.en: scene wienerfight16
scene wienerfight15
scene wienerfight16
scene wienerfight17
: Another 5 damage.
lines.zh: : 又是 5 点伤害。

lines.en: : And then I’m going to use another ki point to make that final attack a stunning strike so, Futaba, go ahead and make a constitution save. That’s the end of my turn.
lines.zh: : 然后我再消耗一点气，把最后一击变成震慑拳，所以 Futaba，你做个体质豁免吧。我的回合结束。

lines.en: scene wienerfight18
: Jeez...I never realized how much stuff monks need to keep track of.
lines.zh: : 天啊……我从没意识到武僧要记的东西这么多。

lines.en: : Yes, it can be quite confusing at first. Now make your saving throw so I can proceed punching you to a non-lethal death.
lines.zh: : 是啊，一开始确实挺让人迷糊的。现在快做你的豁免检定，好让我继续把你非致命地打死。

lines.en: scene wienerfight19
scene wienerfight20
: That’s a...19.
: Okay, so stunning strike doesn’t land and you actually get to take your turn. Consider yourself lucky.
lines.zh: : 好吧，震慑拳没生效，你真的轮到自己的回合了。算你走运。

lines.en: scene wienerfight21
: Great, so I’m at 39 now. You’ve got a way to go, Alentha.
lines.zh: : 太好了，那我现在还有 39 点。Alentha，你还有很长的路要走呢。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. I’ll still get you in the end.
lines.zh: : 好好好。最后我照样能拿下你。

lines.en: : Then...as a bonus action before my attack, I’m going to go into a frenzied rage and-
lines.zh: : 那么……在我攻击之前，用附赠动作进入狂暴怒气，然后——

lines.en: scene wienerfight22
: W-Wait!
lines.zh: : 等、等等！

lines.en: : Hm? What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 嗯？怎么了？

lines.en: : Zagull would...sound angrier than you are right now...
lines.zh: : Zagull 应该……比你现在听起来更生气才对……

lines.en: : Well, I’m sure he would. But there’s no need to really roleplay when it’s just one on one and-
lines.zh: : 嗯，他确实会。不过一对一的时候真的没必要那么代入角色，而且——

lines.en: scene wienerfight23
: But...but Zagull...
lines.zh: : 可是……可是 Zagull……

lines.en: : Ah! Okay! I’ll be...angrier! You don’t have to get upset!
lines.zh: : 啊！好好好！我会……更生气！你别不高兴嘛！

lines.en: : Zagull...grins as he realizes the monk has barely touched him at all and then...holds his greataxe so high in the air that the sun begins to reflect off of it.
lines.zh: : Zagull……咧嘴一笑，因为他发现那个武僧根本没怎么碰到他，然后……他把巨斧高举过头顶，阳光开始在斧刃上反射。

lines.en: scene wienerfight24
: Then he...swings it downward toward the monk’s torso and...
lines.zh: : 然后他……朝武僧的躯干劈下去，然后……

lines.en: scene wienerfight25
: That’s a 19, so it hits.
lines.zh: : 掷出 19，命中了。

lines.en: : Buuuuuut remember that Zagull has disadvantage on all of his melee attacks because Sana was adamant about her one-armed barbarian still using a two-handed weapon.
lines.zh: : 但——是别忘了，Zagull 的所有近战攻击都有劣势，因为 Sana 坚持要她那个独臂蛮战士继续用双手武器。

lines.en: : Oh, right. That...was a thing we decided to do...
lines.zh: : 哦，对。那……是我们之前定下来的……

lines.en: : So then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: scene wienerfight24
scene wienerfight25
: I rolled the same thing, so it’s still a 19.
lines.zh: : 我掷出了同样的点数，所以还是 19。

lines.en: : Oof. Okay. Damage?
lines.zh: : 呃。好吧。伤害多少？

lines.en: scene wienerfight24
scene wienerfight25
: Well?
lines.zh: : 怎样？

lines.en: : I’m going to use savage attacker and see if I can get something higher.
lines.zh: : 我要用野蛮攻击，看看能不能掷出更高的点数。

lines.en: scene wienerfight24
scene wienerfight26
: And I did. So you take 15 total.
lines.zh: : 我做到了。所以你总共吃 15 点。

lines.en: scene wienerfight27
: Feck, d’ya really roll a 12 with that?
lines.zh: : 靠，你真掷出个 12 啊？

lines.en: : Yeah. And as for my second attack...
lines.zh: : 对。至于我的第二次攻击……

lines.en: : Guh. I'm already down to 28 after that, too...
lines.zh: : 呃。被你这么一打，我都已经掉到 28 了……

lines.en: scene black
{i}Away from the nerd stuff...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}远离那群书呆子的玩意儿……{/i}

lines.en: scene wienerfight28
: Back, demon! The instant gram is gone and will not be returning!
lines.zh: : 退后，恶魔！那个 Instagram 已经没了，不会再回来了！

lines.en: : Friend, help! I am going to be consumed!
lines.zh: : 朋友，救命！我要被吃掉了！

lines.en: : Sensei, stay away! I have been dying to see Kaori again ever since that first time in the city and you will not take this away from me!
lines.zh: : Sensei，别过来！自从在城里第一次见面之后，我就一直想再见 Kaori 一面，你休想把她从我身边抢走！

lines.en: : Sorry, Kaori. I’m not on bodyguard duty today.
lines.zh: : 抱歉了，Kaori。我今天不当保镖。

lines.en: : Attractive skull girl, if you continue to stand in that location, I will not be able to assist with the wieners!
lines.zh: : 好看的骷髅女孩，你要是继续站在那个位置，我就没办法帮忙弄香肠了！

lines.en: : I...will help you!
lines.zh: : 我……来帮你！

lines.en: : Sure, I still think they look kind of weird, but I’ll help either way!
lines.zh: : 虽然我还是觉得它们看着有点怪，但不管怎样我都会帮忙！

lines.en: : You...you want to help me grab the wieners?
lines.zh: : 你……你想帮我拿香肠？

lines.en: : Yes! Yes yes yes!
lines.zh: : 想！想想想！

lines.en: : So uhh...heeeeeey.
: Yes, hello. Who’s the girl you brought with you?
lines.zh: : 嗯，你好。你带来的那个女孩是谁？

lines.en: scene wienerfight29
: The one in the hoodie? That’s Rin. She’s a musician too.
lines.zh: : 穿连帽衫的那个？那是 Rin。她也是搞音乐的。

lines.en: : Oh? She wouldn’t be interested in vocal lessons by any chance, would she?
lines.zh: : 哦？她该不会有兴趣上声乐课吧？

lines.en: : I...actually don’t know. I haven’t heard her sing before, but...she’s kind of a little distracted right now.
lines.zh: : 我……其实不知道。我没听她唱过，不过……她现在有点分心。

lines.en: : Can’t talk! Wieners!
lines.zh: : 没空说话！香肠！

lines.en: : I can not get to them with you standing there, skull girl!
lines.zh: : 你站在那儿我够不着它们啊，骷髅女孩！

lines.en: scene wienerfight30
: So is Otoha the only normal girl in your class? Or are there others who were just not able to make it today?
lines.zh: : 所以 Otoha 是你们班上唯一正常的女生？还是有其他正常的只是今天没来？

lines.en: : No, Otoha is the only normal one. You got it right the first time.
lines.zh: : 不，Otoha 就是唯一正常的那个。你第一次就猜对了。

lines.en: : I still think it’s weird that the two of you dated. You’re...not even remotely similar.
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得你们俩居然交往过很奇怪。你们……一点都不像。

lines.en: scene wienerfight31
: Yes, yes. I’m sure it must come as a bit of a shock considering that I’m now a cultural icon and your teacher is the scum of the earth.
lines.zh: : 是是是。考虑到我现在是文化偶像，而你的老师是人间渣滓，你大概确实有点震惊。

lines.en: : Well...I don’t know if I’d go {i}that{/i} far...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我也不至于说得{i}那么绝{/i}……

lines.en: : Believe it or not, Otoha, I actually used to be quite different from the way I am now.
lines.zh: : 信不信由你，Otoha，我以前跟现在其实很不一样。

lines.en: : The Niki Nakayama you see here today is obviously not the same one who dated him, but is a greatly improved version of her former-
lines.zh: : 你今天看到的这个 Niki Nakayama，显然已经不是当年跟他交往的那个了，而是她从前的——大幅升级版——

lines.en: : My penis has probably been in her mouth before.
lines.zh: : 我的鸡巴以前大概进过她的嘴里。

lines.en: scene wienerfight32
: You-
: Probably?...
: How do you not know?
lines.zh: : 你怎么会不知道？

lines.en: : She is my fucking {i}student{/i}, you dick!
lines.zh: : 她可是我他妈的{i}学生{/i}，你这混蛋！

lines.en: : Hey, she’s my student too.
lines.zh: : 嘿，她也是我的学生。

lines.en: : Then you should know better than to fucking say things about your stupid penis to her!
lines.zh: : 那你就该懂点事，别他妈跟她讲你那根蠢鸡巴的事！

lines.en: : It is {i}not{/i} stupid, Niki.
lines.zh: : 它才{i}不{/i}蠢，Niki。

lines.en: : Can we...talk about something else, or?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能……换个话题，或者？

lines.en: : I’m your ex-girlfriend and if I say your penis is stupid, that means it's stupid! My word is law!
lines.zh: : 我是你前女友，我说你那根蠢它就蠢！我的话就是法律！

lines.en: : Oooooor we could keep talking about it. This doesn’t make me uncomfortable at all. Nope.
lines.zh: : 或——者我们可以继续聊这个。我一点都不觉得尴尬。真的。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Several minutes later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}几分钟后……{/i}

lines.en: scene wienerfight33
: Okay...so Zagull’s frenzied rage is still going and I am now at 10 total HP.
lines.zh: : 好吧……Zagull 的狂暴还在持续，我现在总共只剩 10 点生命值。

lines.en: : This is fine. He still has disadvantage on his attacks...and I can still use stunning strike and...
lines.zh: : 没问题。他的攻击还是有劣势……而且我还能用震慑拳，还有……

lines.en: : Yeah. I’ll be okay. Alentha will be okay.
lines.zh: : 对。我会没事的。Alentha 会没事的。

lines.en: : She’s not going to lose to a fecking one-armed orc.
lines.zh: : 她不会输给一个操蛋的独臂兽人的。

lines.en: : B...Beware, Alentha! Zagull Throat Spear is...is going to spear your throat!
lines.zh: : 小、小心了，Alentha！Zagull Throat Spear 要……要刺穿你的喉咙！

lines.en: : Futaba, Zagull doesn’t have a spear...he uses a greataxe, remember?
lines.zh: : Futaba，Zagull 没有矛……他用的是巨斧，记得吗？

lines.en: : Look, it says it right there.
lines.zh: : 你看，这上面写着呢。

lines.en: scene wienerfight34
: Okay, so...
lines.zh: : 好吧，那么……

lines.en: : I wanted to use water whip, but that would mean I wouldn’t be able to stunning strike...which would leave me open to being non-lethally killed on your next turn...so...
lines.zh: : 我本来想用流水鞭的，但那样就没法用震慑拳了……那我就会在你的下个回合被非致命地打死……所以……

lines.en: : Alentha is going to narrow her eyes as she winds up another unarmed attack, channeling the energy around her and manifesting it into flame.
lines.zh: : Alentha 眯起眼睛，蓄力准备又一次徒手攻击，把周围的能量汇聚起来，化作火焰。

lines.en: : Is that...a thing monks can do?
lines.zh: : 武僧……真的能做到这种事吗？

lines.en: : Alentha’s monastic tradition is that of the four elements, so yes. It is a thing she can do.
lines.zh: : Alentha 的武僧流派是四元素，所以可以。她确实做得到。

lines.en: : And since your stupid rage is giving you resistance to bludgeoning, I kind of have to at this point.
lines.zh: : 而且你那个蠢怒气给了你钝击抗性，我现在也只能用这个了。

lines.en: : But damn, water whip is so cool and I wanted to use it.
lines.zh: : 可恶，流水鞭太帅了，我本来想用的。

lines.en: : Anyway, yeah. Alentha uses a ki point and activates fangs of the fire snake and unleashes an unarmed attack on you.
lines.zh: : 总之，对。Alentha 消耗一点气，发动火焰蛇牙，对你打出一次徒手攻击。

lines.en: scene wienerfight35
: Alentha uses another luck point to reroll that attack.
lines.zh: : Alentha 再用一点幸运重掷那次攻击。

lines.en: scene wienerfight34
scene wienerfight35
scene wienerfight34
scene wienerfight35
: First attack connects for 8 total fire damage...bringing Zagull to 22 total HP remaining.
lines.zh: : 第一击命中，造成总共 8 点火焰伤害……Zagull 剩 22 点生命值。

lines.en: : And the second attack is...
lines.zh: : 第二次攻击是……

lines.en: scene wienerfight34
scene wienerfight35
scene wienerfight34
scene wienerfight36
: Another 8 fire damage.
lines.zh: : 又是 8 点火焰伤害。

lines.en: : Wait...are you sure your...fangs of the fire snake works that way?
lines.zh: : 等等……你确定你的……火焰蛇牙是这么用的吗？

lines.en: : I just looked it up on my phone and I’m pretty sure you’d have to use a ki point for every attack you wanted to change from bludgeoning to fire.
lines.zh: : 我刚用手机查了一下，我很确定你想把每一次攻击从钝击改成火焰，都得消耗一点气。

lines.en: scene wienerfight37
: Wait, really? Did I read it incorrectly?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？是我看错了？

lines.en: : That’s-
lines.zh: : 那可——

lines.en: : Oh, wow. Yeah. I’m really sorry. I genuinely didn’t know it worked like that.
lines.zh: : 哦，哇。是啊。真的很抱歉。我是真不知道它是这么运作的。

lines.en: : Well...I’m not going to use another ki point on that when I need to flurry of blows and stun you, sooo...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我还需要气来打疾风连击和震慑你，所以不会再把气花在这上面了，那——

lines.en: : Alentha uses another ki point to unleash a flurry of blows and gets two more attacks.
lines.zh: : Alentha 再消耗一点气发动疾风连击，多得两次攻击。

lines.en: scene wienerfight34
scene wienerfight35
: First one misses.
lines.zh: : 第一击没中。

lines.en: scene wienerfight34
scene wienerfight35
: Second one is a crit, but since you’re resistant it will basically just be normal damage.
lines.zh: : 第二击是暴击，不过因为你有抗性，基本上就等于是普通伤害。

lines.en: scene wienerfight34
scene wienerfight35
: So that’s another seven damage on top of the...twelve from the fire attack and the resistant one. You took nineteen total this turn, bringing you to 11 HP.
lines.zh: : 所以除了火焰攻击的 12 点和被抗掉的那次之外，再加 7 点。你这一回合总共吃了 19 点，还剩 11 点生命值。

lines.en: : I’ll also use my last ki point to make that final blow a stunning strike so...go ahead and save again and then take your turn.
lines.zh: : 我还要用最后一点气，把最后一击变成震慑拳，所以……你再做一次豁免，然后开始你的回合。

lines.en: scene wienerfight38
: Zagull...looks into his opponent’s eyes and spits out a tooth.
lines.zh: : Zagull……盯着对手的眼睛，吐出一颗牙。

lines.en: : {i}Child’s play...You’re not even half my size and you think you can defeat me...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}小儿科……你连我一半大都没有，居然还想打败我……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The battle...isn’t over yet!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}战斗……还没结束呢！{/i}

lines.en: : Alentha readies herself once more and prepares for what could be Zagull’s final onslaught of attacks.
lines.zh: : Alentha 再次摆好架势，准备迎接可能是 Zagull 最后一轮的猛攻。

lines.en: : The sun has begun to set in the distance and-
lines.zh: : 远处的太阳已经开始西沉，而且——

lines.en: : Molly, you’re not DMing right now. You don’t have to set the stage.
lines.zh: : Molly，你现在不是地下城主，不用铺垫场景。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Sorry. Force of habit.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。抱歉。习惯了。

lines.en: : Also, you still have to make your save or you’re stunned.
lines.zh: : 还有，你还是得做豁免，不然就被震慑了。

lines.en: : Oh, right. Sorry.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。抱歉。

lines.en: scene wienerfight39
: That’s a sixteen after my modifier.
lines.zh: : 加上调整值是 16。

lines.en: : Damnit! Okay. Probably gonna die here.
lines.zh: : 可恶！好吧。这下大概要死在这儿了。

lines.en: : So...first melee attack is...
lines.zh: : 那么……第一次近战攻击是……

lines.en: scene wienerfight38
scene wienerfight39
: With disadvantage, remember.
lines.zh: : 别忘了有劣势。

lines.en: : I know, I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道，我知道。

lines.en: scene wienerfight38
scene wienerfight39
: First attack...doesn’t hit.
lines.zh: : 第一击……没中。

lines.en: : But that’s okay! Because I still have one more plus my frenzy attack.
lines.zh: : 不过没关系！因为我还有一次攻击，加上狂暴攻击。

lines.en: scene wienerfight38
scene wienerfight39
scene wienerfight38
scene wienerfight40
: Okay...I guess the second attack doesn’t land either.
lines.zh: : 好吧……看来第二击也没中。

lines.en: : Wait, Futaba. Aren’t those Rin’s dice?
lines.zh: : 等等，Futaba。那不是 Rin 的骰子吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I forgot mine at home so-
lines.zh: : 对，我把自己的忘在家里了，所以——

lines.en: scene wienerfight41
: Oh no!
lines.zh: : 不好！

lines.en: : It's not her! It's the dice!
lines.zh: : 不是她的问题！是骰子的问题！

lines.en: : BAHAHAHAHA! FEAR ME, ORC!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈！怕了吧，兽人！

lines.en: scene wienerfight42
: That’s okay...I still have the frenzy attack...
lines.zh: : 没关系……我还有狂暴攻击……

lines.en: : Believe, Zagull...believe...
lines.zh: : 相信吧，Zagull……相信吧……

lines.en: scene wienerfight43
: So far so good...
lines.zh: : 目前为止还好……

lines.en: scene wienerfight42
scene wienerfight43
scene wienerfight44
: Oh no...that look...
lines.zh: : 不好……那个眼神……

lines.en: : Don’t tell me-
lines.zh: : 你不会是要——

lines.en: : How much health do you have again?
lines.zh: : 你还有多少生命值来着？

lines.en: : Ah! That’s the worst possible thing you could ask someone in a tabletop game!
lines.zh: : 啊！在桌游里问这种话是最要命的！

lines.en: : Wait! Don’t shoot!
lines.zh: : 等等！别打！

lines.en: : Time to die, {i}monk{/i}...
lines.zh: : 是时候去死了，{i}武僧{/i}……

lines.en: : I...I have 10 HP...
lines.zh: : 我……我还有 10 点生命值……

lines.en: scene wienerfight45
: Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: scene wienerfight46
: Shit.
: Wait...you still have...savage attacker...so you can reroll the damage dice...
lines.zh: : 等等……你还有……野蛮攻击……所以你可以重掷伤害骰……

lines.en: scene wienerfight47
: R-Right! I’ve never been so thankful for a reroll before!
lines.zh: : 对、对啊！我从没这么感激过还有重掷的机会！

lines.en: : Here...here goes nothing!
lines.zh: : 来……豁出去了！

lines.en: scene wienerfight48
: Hey guys, how’s the game going? Did anyone-
lines.zh: : 嘿各位，游戏怎么样了？有没有人——

lines.en: : Oh shit, Futaba rolled my lucky number.
lines.zh: : 哦操，Futaba 掷出了我的幸运数字。

lines.en: : MWAHAHAHAHAHA! ALENTHA LIVES ANOTHER DAY!
lines.zh: : 哇哈哈哈哈哈！ALENTHA 又活过了一天！

lines.en: scene black
{i}Roughly five minutes later...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}大约五分钟后……{/i}

lines.en: scene wienerfight49
: I did it, Sir! I defeated Zagull Throat Spear!
lines.zh: : 我做到了，老师！我打败了 Zagull Throat Spear！

lines.en: : It got really close at the end, but I-
lines.zh: : 最后真的非常惊险，不过我——

lines.en: : That’s nice, Molly. Congratulations.
lines.zh: : 挺好的，Molly。恭喜。

lines.en: scene wienerfight50
: Don’t...Don't you want to hear about my epic tale of bravery and strength? And how I overcame adversity in the face of danger through willpower and-
lines.zh: : 你难道……你难道不想听听我那勇气与力量交织的史诗故事吗？还有我是怎么靠意志力在危难中逆境翻盘的——

lines.en: : I wouldn’t really understand any of it, to be completely honest. So there’s really no point.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我大概一句都听不懂。所以真的没什么意义。

lines.en: : Well...okay.
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧。

lines.en: : I won, though. So...I guess I’ll just text Uta and tell her.
lines.zh: : 不过我赢了。所以……我还是发短信告诉 Uta 好了。

lines.en: : Things...are really not looking good for the first floor, are they?
lines.zh: : 一楼的形势……看起来真的不太妙啊。

lines.en: : There’s always...whatever other competitions are being held today, I guess.
lines.zh: : 不是还有……今天剩下的那些比赛嘛，大概。

lines.en: : Right...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : There are still four more, so we could {i}technically{/i} come back if we...just keep winning until the competition is over.
lines.zh: : 还剩四场，所以{i}理论上{/i}如果我们……一路赢到比赛结束，还是能追回来的。

lines.en: : But the next contest could probably go either way, so...
lines.zh: : 不过下一场大概胜负难料，所以……

lines.en: : What’s the next contest?
lines.zh: : 下一场是什么？

lines.en: : It’s the Chika versus Touka battle, but we’re not allowed to tell you any more than that.
lines.zh: : 是 Chika 对 Touka 的一战，不过再多我们就不能说了。

lines.en: scene black
My phone begins to go off in my pocket and-
lines.zh: 我口袋里的手机开始震动，然后——

lines.en: Wait, I went to sleep without a charger. How is it alive again?
lines.zh: 等等，我睡前根本没充电器。它怎么还有电的？

lines.en: Either way, I answer the phone and step away from Molly and Futaba.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我接起电话，从 Molly 和 Futaba 身边走开。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Hihi~
lines.zh: : 嗨嗨~

lines.en: : Is the Molly and Futaba thing over yet?
lines.zh: : Molly 和 Futaba 那场结束了没？

lines.en: : It just ended. Molly won.
lines.zh: : 刚结束。Molly 赢了。

lines.en: : Damnit. The second floor has a pretty big lead then, huh?
lines.zh: : 可恶。那二楼领先挺多的吧？

lines.en: : They’re ahead, but it’s not impossible to come back, I guess.
lines.zh: : 她们是领先，不过我觉得也不是追不回来。

lines.en: : Course it’s not! Especially since my contest starts right now!
lines.zh: : 当然追得回来！尤其是我的比赛马上就要开始了！

lines.en: : How long will it take you to get to my house from there?
lines.zh: : 你从那儿到我家要多久？

lines.en: : Your house? Uhh...like thirty minutes, probably?
lines.zh: : 你家？呃……大概三十分钟？

lines.en: : Perfect! Head over right now and ring the bell when you get here. Got it?
lines.zh: : 正好！现在就过来，到了按门铃。记住了吗？

lines.en: : Got it. But what is-
lines.zh: : 记住了。可是那是——

lines.en: : Love you! Bye!
lines.zh: : 爱你！拜拜！

lines.en: Chika hangs up and...I apparently have to go to her house for whatever the next contest is.
lines.zh: Chika 挂了电话，而我……看来得为了不知道是什么的下一场比赛去她家。

lines.en: I slide my magical phone back into my pocket and say goodbye to everyone.
lines.zh: 我把那部神奇的手机塞回口袋，跟所有人道别。

lines.en: None of the girls follow me for the first time in two days and...
lines.zh: 两天以来第一次，没有任何一个女生跟上来，然后……

lines.en: Well, I guess I just...go to Chika’s house.
lines.zh: 嗯，那我就……直接去 Chika 家吧。
